longDescription: Weir Mitchell is a satirical narrative combining elements of autobiography and fiction, written during the late 19th century. The story follows a rather dubious character named Ezra Sanderaft, who reflects on his life and misadventures while lying in a hospital bed due to a serious illness.

authorInfo.bio: S. Weir (Silas Weir) Mitchell (1829–1914) is the author of The Autobiography of a Quack, and The Case of George Dedlow. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
